method: Node production physics and controller; no browser/device acceptance

checks.name: Difficulty is selectable, persists through settings validation, and uses default speed
Oracle matches live fixed-step walls, spin, curves, expiry and newly spawned effects
Every reachable deterministic test shot is defended without exceeding the speed cap
Unreachable shots can beat Demigod; no teleport, collision bypass or score suppression
Team attack search is reused and chooses legal non-central offensive contacts
Demigod has shared benefits; legacy difficulties retain restricted returns and shields
Invalid dt is ignored, instant reversal is allowed, and prediction never consumes global RNG
Continuous production steps, serves, scoring and effect cycles stay finite
